column1: # The genomes the validation runs on. Reads are simulated from each one and given to BrucellaID.
# accessions: NCBI nucleotide accessions, chromosome 1 first, separated by ";".
# reference, species, biovar: what the identification must return. "-" means "not checked": a genome that is
# not in the sketch is only expected to give the right species, and a genome that is not Brucella is expected
# not to be identified at all (species ND).
# coverage: the depth the reads are simulated at. "-" means the depth the run asked for (COVERAGE, 20 unless
# set); a number is that depth no matter what the run asked for, and check_results.py then also checks that
# the k-mer copy threshold rose with the depth and that the sketch stayed clean.
# The sequence type is not listed: check_results.py reads it off the genome itself, by looking for an exact
# match of every MLST allele, and compares that with what BrucellaID called from the reads.
